leadText:
Honeymooners (Japanese: ハネムーン Honeymoon) are a pair of Pokémon Trainers introduced in Generation VI.

In Generation VI, Honeymooners are depicted as a male and a young female on their honeymoon who can challenge the player to a Double Battle.

In Generation VII, the pair is formed by a male and a female . Like Sightseers, Honeymooners in Alola use the Kantonian variants of Pokémon that have Alolan forms.
